text: Microsoft AI says it finished pre-training MAI-Base-2, a 2.8 trillion parameter model trained on 16,000 Nvidia GB200 chips in 38 days. CEO Mustafa Suleyman told staff it beats the base model behind GPT 5.6 Sol using a quarter of OpenAI's compute.
